description: The pie chart represents the distribution of two types of tasks in a study on generative AI's use in journalism. There are two slices in the chart. The larger slice, which covers approximately 83.2% of the chart, is labeled "Article generation" and is colored in red. The smaller slice, which covers about 16.8% of the chart, is labeled "Headline generation" and is colored in yellow. The chart includes percentage labels inside the slices, indicating the proportion of each task type. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way, and the chart does not include a legend. The segments are ordered with the larger slice for "Article generation" followed by the smaller slice for "Headline generation."
